title: The Vampire Altar
description: NightWalker gives vampires a real progression surface rather than a generic list of inherited gifts. Lestat calls the altar temptation with paperwork: inspect the powers and weaknesses the system actually permits before choosing what the blood will become.
description_completed: The Overlord has opened NightWalker's Vampire Altar and seen the real power-and-weakness progression available to this vampiric state.
